headline: Gold prices jump: Price per bhori increases by 9,856 taka
summary: Gold prices in Bangladesh have seen a significant spike, with the cost per bhori rising by nearly 10,000 taka in a single step.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have experienced a sharp increase, with the cost per bhori rising by 9,856 taka in a single update.
Reports indicate that the price of gold has surged across the country, marking a significant jump in the market value.
In a broader trend, gold prices have increased by more than 12,000 taka per bhori across two consecutive price hikes.
The sudden rise in prices is impacting consumers and the jewelry market as the cost of the precious metal continues to climb.
caption:
Gold prices just took a massive leap! The cost per bhori has jumped by 9,856 taka in a single step.

Gold prices in Bangladesh have experienced a sharp increase, with the cost per bhori rising by 9,856 taka in a single update.

headline: Ex-Gazipur MP Akhtaruzzaman arrested in Dhaka
summary: The 73-year-old former Awami League lawmaker was picked up by the Detective Branch from Baridhara.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police arrested former Gazipur-5 MP Akhtaruzzaman from the capital's Baridhara area last night.
The 73-year-old former Awami League lawmaker was apprehended around 9:30 pm, according to DMP Additional Commissioner (DB) Mohammad Shafiqul Islam.
Police officials stated that the arrest was made based on intelligence information regarding his involvement in activities linked to a banned organization.
Additionally, Akhtaruzzaman is accused in a murder case related to the July uprising.
caption:
A former lawmaker from Gazipur is in custody. He faces allegations of links to a banned organization and a murder case.

The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police arrested former Gazipur-5 MP Akhtaruzzaman from the capital's Baridhara area last night.

The 73-year-old former Awami League lawmaker was apprehended around 9:30 pm, according to DMP Additional Commissioner (DB) Mohammad Shafiqul Islam.

Police officials stated that the arrest was made based on intelligence information regarding his involvement in activities linked to a banned organization.

Additionally, Akhtaruzzaman is accused in a murder case related to the July uprising.

#Bangladesh #Gazipur #Politics #Dhaka #News

Source: The Daily Star, Somoy News
